mapper.sql: FROM account a LEFT JOIN account_state s ON s.account_id=a.id AND s.tenant_id=a.tenant_id LEFT JOIN account_credential c ON c.account_id=a.id AND c.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT WHERE a.id=#{id} AND a.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT id FROM account WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT updated_at FROM account_credential WHERE account_id=#{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account_group WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND id IN #{id}
SELECT * FROM account_tier_check_task WHERE id=#{id}
SELECT * FROM account_tier_check_task WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM account_tier_check_task WHERE created_by=#{userId} AND request_id=#{requestId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account_tier_check_task WHERE 1=1
SELECT * FROM account_tier_check_task WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{q.pageSize} OFFSET #{q.offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status=3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS success, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status=4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS failed, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status=5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS unqueryable, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN (1,2) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS pending, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN (3,4,5) AND tier_change=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS `first`, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN (3,4,5) AND tier_change=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS `same`, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN (3,4,5) AND tier_change=2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS `up`, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN (3,4,5) AND tier_change=3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS `down`, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN (3,4,5) AND tier_change=4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS `unknown`, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN (3,4,5) AND tier_change=5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS `lost` FROM account_tier_check_item WHERE task_id=#{taskId}
SELECT trust_tier,COUNT(*) AS count FROM account_tier_check_item WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND status=3 AND trust_tier IS NOT NULL GROUP BY trust_tier
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account_tier_check_item WHERE
SELECT * FROM account_tier_check_item WHERE ORDER BY id LIMIT #{q.pageSize} OFFSET #{q.offset}
SELECT * FROM account_tier_check_item WHERE id=#{id}
SELECT * FROM account_tier_check_item WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND status=3 AND id<>#{excludeId} ORDER BY checked_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT i.id AS item_id,i.task_id,t.name AS task_name,t.mode,i.checked_at,i.trust_tier,i.prev_trust_tier,i.tier_change,i.status,i.reason_code FROM account_tier_check_item i INNER JOIN account_tier_check_task t ON t.id=i.task_id AND t.tenant_id=i.tenant_id WHERE i.account_id=#{accountId} AND i.checked_at IS NOT NULL AND t.created_by=#{ownerId} ORDER BY i.checked_at DESC,i.id DESC
SELECT account_id FROM account_tier_check_item WHERE task_id=#{taskId} ORDER BY account_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account_tier_check_item WHERE executor_account_id=#{executorId} AND (status=2 OR next_execute_at>#{now})
SELECT * FROM account_tier_check_item WHERE executor_account_id=#{executorId} AND attempt_no>0 ORDER BY last_attempt_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account_tier_check_item WHERE executor_account_id=#{executorId} AND status IN (1,2)
mapper.update: UPDATE account_tier_check_item SET status=2,executor_account_id=#{executorAccountId},executor_round_count=#{executorRoundCount},attempt_no=attempt_no+1,last_attempt_at=#{updatedAt},reason_code=NULL,checked_at=NULL,next_execute_at=#{nextExecuteAt},updated_at=#{updatedAt} WHERE id=#{id} AND status=1 AND attempt_no=#{attemptNo}
UPDATE account_tier_check_item SET WHERE id=#{id} AND status=2 AND attempt_no=#{attemptNo}
UPDATE account_tier_check_item SET WHERE id=#{id} AND status=1 AND attempt_no=#{attemptNo}
UPDATE account_tier_check_item SET next_execute_at=#{nextAt},updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND status=1
UPDATE account_tier_check_item SET status=6,reason_code='TASK_STOPPED',updated_at=#{now} WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND status=1
UPDATE account_tier_check_item SET status=1,reason_code=NULL,checked_at=NULL,tier_change=0,updated_at=#{now} WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND status=4
UPDATE account_tier_check_item SET status=#{status},reason_code='QUERY_RELEASED',updated_at=#{now},next_execute_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{item.id} AND status=2 AND attempt_no=#{item.attemptNo}
UPDATE account_tier_check_task SET status=#{status},updated_at=#{now},finished_at=CASE WHEN #{status}=1 THEN NULL ELSE #{now} END WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT i.tenant_id,i.task_id,i.id AS item_id FROM account_tier_check_item i INNER JOIN account_tier_check_task t ON t.id=i.task_id AND t.tenant_id=i.tenant_id LEFT JOIN account_state s ON s.account_id=i.executor_account_id AND s.tenant_id=i.tenant_id WHERE i.status=2 AND (i.next_execute_at<=#{now} OR (t.mode=2 AND (s.login_state IS NULL OR s.login_state<>1))) ORDER BY i.next_execute_at,i.id LIMIT #{limit}
